mapper.select: SELECT id, merchant_id, contact_type, contact_name, email, phone, notify_enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM merchant_contact WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_contact (merchant_id, contact_type, contact_name, email, phone, notify_enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{merchantId}, #{contactType}, #{contactName}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{notifyEnabled}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE merchant_contact SET contact_type = #{contactType}, contact_name = #{contactName}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, notify_enabled = #{notifyEnabled}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND merchant_id = #{merchantId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM merchant_contact WHERE id = #{id} AND merchant_id = #{merchantId}
